headline: Samsung Wallet picks Solana for USDC transfers

scenes.vo: Samsung is putting stablecoins in the wallet on eighty-two million American Galaxy phones, using Solana. Here's what changed.
Samsung Wallet and Samsung Pay will support stablecoins on Solana. Starting the last week of October, users in the U S can send USDC across borders, with cash in and out built in.
Here's why traders are watching it. Most people will never download a crypto app. This puts digital dollars in a wallet that already ships on their phone.
The catch. It isn't live yet, it starts in the U S only, and other countries depend on local rules. Users send USDC, not SOL itself.
Here's what happens next. Watch the late October launch, how many people actually use it, and which countries come next.
